1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

7: 
8:   // Ship
9:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 40, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 5 };
10: 
11:   // Input
12:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
13:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
14:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
15: 
16:   // Game state
17:   let asteroids = [];
18:   let fuels = [];
19:   let fuel = 100; // percent
20:   let score = 0;
21:   let gameOver = false;
22:   let frame = 0;
23: 
24:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
25:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
26:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
27:   };
28:   const spawnFuel = () => {
29:     const size = 20;
30:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 2 });
31:   };
32: 
33:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
34: 
35:   const update = () => {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     // Move ship
38:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
39:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
40: 
41:     // Spawn
42:     if (frame % 90 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
43:     if (frame % 600 === 0) spawnFuel();
44: 
45:     // Update asteroids
46:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
47:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y < height);
48: 
49:     // Update fuels
50:     fuels.forEach(f => f.y += f.speed);
51:     fuels = fuels.filter(f => f.y < height);
52: 
53:     // Collision detection
54:     for (let i = 0; i < asteroids.length; i++) {
55:       const a = asteroids[i];
56:       if (rectIntersect(ship, a)) { gameOver = true; break; }
57:       // Score when passed bottom
58:       if (a.y > height) { score++; asteroids.splice(i, 1); i--; }
59:     }
60:     for (let i = 0; i < fuels.length; i++) {
61:       const f = fuels[i];
62:       if (rectIntersect(ship, f)) { fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 30); fuels.splice(i, 1); i--; }
63:     }
64: 
65:     // Fuel drain
66:     fuel -= 0.05;
67:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
68: 
69:     frame++;
70:   };
71: 
72:   const draw = () => {
73:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
74:     // Ship (triangle)
75:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
76:     ctx.beginPath();
77:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
78:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
79:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y - ship.h);
80:     ctx.closePath();
81:     ctx.fill();
82:     // Asteroids
83:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
84:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
85:     // Fuel cans
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
87:     fuels.forEach(f => ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.w, f.h));
88:     // Fuel bar
89:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
90:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 10);
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
92:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, fuel, 10);
93:     // Score
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
95:     ctx.font = '16px Arial';
96:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, width - 100, 20);
97:     // Game over
98:     if (gameOver) {
99:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
100:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
101:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
102:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
103:       ctx.font = '48px Arial';
104:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
105:     }
106:   };
107: 
108:   const loop = () => {
109:     if (!gameOver) update();
110:     draw();
111:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
112:   };
113:   loop();
114: })();
